title: Skills Army HQ — Git Sync Pulse Projection Context
sources: rebalanceOS experimental/git-pulse/collect.sh:475-601 and pulse.py:797-915 (scheduled checkout reconciliation and publication, recorded by recon)
legend_note: Solid arrows are current flows. Dashed arrows are the proposed explicit, single-publisher projection. Dotted arrows are local metadata or symlink state. The scheduled live pulse checkout remains a separate producer and is never the Skills Army HQ collection.

groups.label: Existing scheduled pulse writers — separate path

nodes.label: Local skill source repos
nodes.description: Existing local Git folders accepted one at a time by Skills Army HQ intake.

nodes.label: Skills Army HQ collection A
nodes.description: Authoritative local payload copies. The completed deployment contained 15 skills and remained independent of Git Sync Pulse.

nodes.label: Device A state
nodes.description: Absolute root, target paths, ownership receipts, transaction state, backups and history stay device-local and are excluded from projection.

nodes.label: Device A app roots
nodes.description: Claude, Codex and Gemini-compatible discovery roots read through local managed links.

nodes.label: Isolated projection checkout
nodes.description: Proposed explicit single-publisher checkout containing portable payloads only; not used by scheduled pulse jobs.

nodes.label: Private Git Sync Pulse remote
nodes.description: Optional transport location. It does not become deployment authority and gains no new background writer during the spike.

nodes.label: Explicit consumer checkout
nodes.description: A separate checkout pulled explicitly before importing; never the scheduled live pulse checkout.

nodes.label: Skills Army HQ collection B
nodes.description: Independent authoritative collection populated through existing add/update operations.

nodes.label: Device B state
nodes.description: Device B retains its own absolute targets, ownership receipts, lock and recovery state.

nodes.label: Device B app roots
nodes.description: Existing sync machinery deploys imported skills to enabled app roots on Device B.

nodes.label: Git Pulse collector
nodes.description: Existing bounded writer that pulls, stages generated pulse/device paths, commits and pushes.

nodes.label: Rebalance pulse publisher
nodes.description: Independent existing writer that reconciles and publishes live-pulse.md.

nodes.label: Scheduled live pulse checkout
nodes.description: Generated-data checkout with multiple writers and a documented dirty-tree failure history. It must not host the HQ collection or projection worktree.
